== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The revised Lost Pile condition permits ties. The loss timing goes from ‘about to lose’ to ‘whenever you lose.’ ‘You may not play Out Of Commission’ changes to ‘Out Of Commission is canceled.’ The reduction cost and Alter immunity agree.
